standard_prerequisites.name: The vanishing of local cohomology with support in a closed subset above the dimension of the ring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author lemma lemma-cd-dimension, whose statement is reproduced verbatim as a context span of this card (source lines 758-764)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the bound on the cohomological dimension of the support functor.

standard_prerequisites.name: The colimit description of the sections with support in a specialization-stable subset, and the bounded below case of the equivalence
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author lemmas lemma-adjoint-ext and lemma-equal-plus, whose statements are reproduced verbatim as context spans of this card (source lines 996-1004 and 1019-1024)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first transfers the vanishing of the local cohomology to the general support, the second supplies the equivalence on bounded below complexes.

core_obligations: Bound the functor: if the ring has dimension d, the local cohomology with support in any closed subset vanishes above d, and the colimit description of the support functor then shows that the zeroth support functor has bounded cohomological dimension (proof lines 1062-1066)

Bounded below case: for a complex supported in T the canonical map from the derived zeroth support functor to the identity is an isomorphism when the complex is bounded below, which is the content of the previously proved bounded below equivalence (proof lines 1068-1071)

Remove the boundedness: because the functor has bounded cohomological dimension, the i-th cohomology of the image depends only on the truncation of the complex in degrees at least -d + i, so the isomorphism extends to all complexes supported in T (proof lines 1071-1073)
Conclude: the functor is an equivalence with quasi-inverse given by the derived zeroth support functor (proof lines 1074-1075)
proof_roadmap: 设 dim(A) = d。任一闭子集 Z 上 H^i_Z(M) = 0 (i > d)，由 lemma-adjoint-ext 的 colim 描述可知 H^0_T 的 cohomological dimension 有界。
对 K ∈ D_T(A)，先用 lemma-equal-plus 得有界下方时的同构；再由上述有界性，RH^0_T(K) 的第 i 个上同调只依赖 τ_{≥ -d + i}K，故同构对一切 K 成立，遂得 D(Mod_{A,T}) → D_T(A) 为等价，拟逆 RH^0_T。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement extends the equivalence between the derived category of modules supported in a specialization-stable subset and the full subcategory of complexes with that support from bounded below complexes to all complexes, at the cost of assuming that the ring has finite dimension (author lemma at source lines 1054-1059, label lemma-equal-full). The proof (source lines 1061-1076) first bounds the cohomological dimension of the support functor using the vanishing of local cohomology above the dimension of the ring together with the colimit description of the functor, then quotes the bounded below case and removes the boundedness hypothesis by a truncation argument: the i-th cohomology of the image depends only on the truncation in degrees at least -d + i (proof lines 1071-1073). The truncation argument on top of the bounded below equivalence is the content; all three input statements are reproduced as context spans. H2.
